title: Multilingual Lecture Captioning & Translation

engineFeatures.meaning: low-pass and noise added at training time

label: For "Multilingual Lecture Captioning & Translation": Provide accurate live and recorded captions and translations for lectures in many languages with technical vocabulary. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Test set lacks code-switching.
